items.difficulty_reason: Equivalence theorem (statement 7675-7688, proof 7690-7763): the unbounded derived-category equivalence for quasi-coherent modules along an fppf hypercovering, proven by an explicit one-by-one verification of the five criterion conditions - two dispatched by citation of dedicated lemmas whose statements are exactly the required conditions, three by concrete choices (affine objects, affine coverings) with the vanishing computed through the sanity-check lemma and affine vanishing; no omitted steps. H2: condition-checking proof in the style of the chapter's descent section.
